page.layout: One page of text, set in narrow centred lines. Below the text: a printer's fleuron (ornament) and a closing word "FINIS." in spaced capitals. A library stamp at lower right. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right.

main_text.p: tur, cùm quæ aut modo, aut tempore, diuer-sam rationem habent, quasi vnum & idem perpetuò essent, fumuntur. huius autem captionis vsus est in Soritis vel maxi-mus:cùm is qui interrogatur,im-prudens ab eo quod con-cesit, ad id quod non vult concedere, deducitur.

page.notes: The text is set in centred lines, so the paragraph is one block with line-end hyphens kept. Long s is normalised to s and u/v to the modern spelling (vnum, vsus, est). The fleuron above FINIS and the library stamp are not printed text and are omitted.
